name: KP08 · Mini-Tech
description: 8 mm shaft · 55 × 13 × 29 mm · cast KP housing

specifications.label: Insert width and position
specifications.value: K and S are blank in the supplied KP08 table. Insert width 12 mm and axial offset −2 mm are illustrative.

specifications.label: Mounting-hole source discrepancy
specifications.value: The drawing gives N = 4.5 mm. The product text says M5, which does not match a 4.5 mm clearance bore. Geometry uses N as the through-hole diameter, without a modeled thread; confirm the fastener fit on the physical part.

specifications.label: Geometry limits
specifications.value: Cast housing crown width/depth, recesses, ribs, bearing sections, seals and socket set screws are visual approximations. Round mounting holes use N; elongated slot length is not dimensioned. No rolling elements or self-alignment simulation.
